prompts.style: Documentary press photograph, 35mm Kodak Portra film, flash and grain: reads as a real news photo, the opposite of glossy AI
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 photograph. A plain, tired-looking middle-aged British man in a rumpled navy tweed-textured suit and loosened tie stands braced with both hands on the trunk of a tall tree, shaking it hard. Hundreds of crisp pale-green and purple banknotes tumble down like autumn leaves, drifting around his shoulders and heaping ankle-deep at his feet on wet grass. A blank brass plaque is screwed to the trunk. Overcast grey London park, shot on 35mm Portra film, 50mm lens at f/2.8, slight motion blur on falling notes, visible film grain, muted natural colour. Thanks.

prompts.style: Gouache storybook illustration, flat shapes and visible brush texture: fable register suits a satirical parable
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 gouache and ink illustration in the manner of a mid-century British children's picture book. A balding, slightly stout middle-aged man in a brown wool suit grips the trunk of a squat, round-crowned tree and shakes it, eyes squeezed shut in effort. Banknotes in ochre, teal and cream swirl down like autumn leaves and pile in a rustling heap around his shoes. A blank cream plaque hangs on the trunk. Matte opaque paint, visible dry-brush texture, limited warm palette, paper grain, soft flat shadows, generous empty sky at the top. Thanks.

prompts.style: Linocut and screenprint propaganda poster: bold two-ink graphic, a deliberate break from both photo and paint
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 three-colour screenprint poster in a 1930s Soviet constructivist and linocut style: black, mustard yellow and money green on cream paper. A broad-shouldered middle-aged man in a plain dark suit, shown in dramatic low-angle, shakes a thick-trunked tree with a bold stylised crown. Banknotes cascade down in rhythmic diagonal strokes, drifting like leaves and heaping at his feet. A blank rectangular plaque is nailed to the trunk. Chunky carved line work, slight ink misregistration, rough print texture, strong geometric composition, no lettering. Thanks.
